title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-mar-2026-asha-scratchpad
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Date: 2026-03-19 // 10:00 - 11:00 PT (30m core + optional follow-ups)
Owner (prep): Asha Patel
Goal: Align on priorities for Q2 sprint planning: which infra & model-investments to prioritize to hit latency/cost targets for hosted API and Dedicated.
Participants: PMs (Asha, Maya), Eng leads (Raj - serving runtime, Dylan - infra), Applied ML (Olivia), SRE (TBD)

High-level agenda (rough)
- 10m: Quick status + metrics snapshot (Asha)
  - current p50/p95 gen latency (hosted): 110ms / 420ms (region us-west2)
  - cost per 1k tokens trending +8% month-over-month (cache misses rising)
  - top customer regressions flagged in QA: 3 regressions tied to new decoder change
- 15m: Proposed roadmap items and asks (each 3-4 min)
  - Product ask: prioritize 2 model variants for canary (smaller quantized + baseline) for customers with latency-sensitive SLAs (Maya)
  - Eng ask: runtime changes needed to support continuous KV cache sharing across pods + batching improvements (Raj)
  - Applied ML ask: run targeted quant evals and produce regression/quality deltas (Olivia)
  - Infra ask: capacity plan for Dedicated opt-in low-latency pools (Dylan)
- 5m: Decision criteria + next steps (Asha)

Notes to surface in meeting:
- model families impacted: LLama-2-13B, RedModel-7B, ORT-11B
- prioritize customers requesting sub-200ms p95 (4 customers; list with Maya)

Discussion points / prompts to raise
- For Applied ML (Olivia): what's the quality delta expected from 6-bit quant vs 8-bit on common LLM families? any known failure modes for instruction-following?
- For Eng (Raj/Dylan): what's the rough ETA and risk for rolling out cross-pod KV cache within Dedicated? Can we ship an opt-in flag first? Impact on memory/GC?
- For Product (Maya/Asha): tradeoff threshold: accept +1.5% model quality drop for 30-40% cost reduction? or target <0.5% quality change? Need a decision boundary.

Risks / unknowns
- Quantization regressions on edge-case prompts (long-range dependencies) - need eval set (Olivia)
- Runtime changes might increase tail latencies during GC/eviction if not tuned (Raj)
- Rollout coordination: Dedicated customers need separate canary channels; Private deployments will need different docs / approvals.

Metrics to surface in sync (prep items)
- p50/p95 generation time by model family and region (Eng)
- cache hit rate and median tokens saved (Eng)
- end-to-end cost per 1k tokens before/after changes (Finance or Product analytic slice)
- quality regression delta on standard eval set + targeted customer prompt set (Applied ML)

Concrete asks (pre-meeting)
- Raj: bring rough timeframe + breaking changes list for KV cache sharing (ETA, perf numbers from prototype) - due: meeting
- Olivia: produce a small eval summary of quantization on the 3 high-priority models (LLama-2-13B, RedModel-7B, ORT-11B) with examples of failure cases - due: 2026-03-24
- Dylan: updated capacity plan showing how many Dedicated pools could be converted to opt-in low-latency config and expected cost delta - due: 2026-03-25
- Maya: consolidate customer asks + SLAs (top 5 customers) and prioritize the list - due: 2026-03-21

Decision matrix (proposal)
- If quantization + runtime batching yields >=25% cost reduction with <=0.7% quality delta on both standard eval and 3 customer prompt sets => greenlight broad canary across Hosted & Dedicated (staged).
- Otherwise, continue targeted opt-in canary for latency-sensitive customers only.

Follow-ups / action items from last sync (status)
- Asha: PRD draft for low-latency offering - in review (link in CONF-5123)
- Raj: prototype for dynamic batching (benchmarks attached to PR) - blocked on PR infra small fix (INF-2345)
- Olivia: eval harness updated with customer prompt set - done, uploading results later today

Prep checklist for meeting
- Bring the perf dashboards (Asha) + link to live Grafana (share before meeting)
- Attach eval artifacts (Olivia) + a 1-page TL;DR on major failure modes
- Short list of customers with strict latency requirements and contacts (Maya)
- Quick demo of KV cache prototype (Raj) if time permits (5 min)

Open questions to resolve post-meeting
- Can we expose opt-in KV cache flag to Dedicated customers without a full infra migration? (Eng to confirm)
- Who signs off on quality thresholds for rollouts? Product + Applied ML or include CS?
- Document rollback criteria for canary (thresholds for p95 increase, quality drop) - assign to Asha/Maya.

Tone notes (for me):
- Keep the convo pragmatic, avoid deep model-research dives unless Olivia flags a critical regression.
- Push for concrete acceptance criteria (numbers).

Attachments to add after meeting:
- snapshot_p50_p95_2026-03-16.png
- eval_quant_summary_2026-03-17.csv
- PR-1123-kv-cache-demo-recording.mp4

Quick to-dos after meeting (if we agree on canary):
- Create RFC in docs (Asha) + link to rollout checklist (due within 48h)
- Add canary flag to deployment templates (Raj + Dylan)
- Run 2-week eval against customer prompts (Olivia)

----
Personal scratch notes:
- Don't forget to call out Dedicated vs Hosted differences in rollout doc.
- Check with Legal about data residency for caching changes (ask Security team)
- Follow up with SRE on alerting thresholds for increased tail latency
notes:
- Quick notes to self: keep the discussion concrete: tie asks to numbers (ms savings, $/1k tokens).
- Need clarity on capacity: how many dedicated pools would be impacted by KV cache change? (estimate from infra)
- Customer signal: 4 customers asked for sub-200ms p95 in 2 regions (sales tickets linked)
summary: Draft prep + checklist for roadmap alignment sync covering quantization, KV cache sharing, batching, metrics to surface, decision thresholds, and action owners.
